newsitem.title: SPAIN: Venezuela aims to decide on debt plan mid-April.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela aims to decide on debt plan mid-April.

text.p: Finance Minister Luis Raul Matos Azocar said on Tuesday Venezuela was aiming to make a decision on a plan to smooth out repayments on outstanding commercial debt by the middle of next month.
"The agenda is to decide by the middle of April," he told reporters on the fringes of the Inter-American Development Bank's annual meeting.
Venezuela currently faces a front-loading of payments on outstanding debt in 1998 and 1999.

Under current terms Venezuela would have to pay $3 billion, or 40 percent of ordinary income, every year through 1999 to service its outstanding debt. Matos said Venezuela was aiming to reduce this to 25 percent.

Caracas has requested proposals from some 20 investment banks to come up with a formula to ease its payment schedule. Some $25 billion of debt would be eligible, however a lesser amount could finally be involved. --Caroline Brothers, IADB Newsroom +34 3 424 2834
